integrity: The residual operator is derived directly from the two relaxed coordinate updates. Positive-semidefiniteness of I-R^T R gives the exact ceiling, while the SOR spectral-radius optimum is independently recovered from the 2x2 error matrix. The exact witness is replayed with rational arithmetic; finite checks do not replace the analytic quantifiers.
scientific_limitations: Exact-arithmetic one-sweep theorem for the canonical unit-diagonal 2x2 SPD family under natural-order forward SOR. It does not claim a robust optimum over all unequal-diagonal 2x2 SPD matrices, higher dimensions, other orderings, SSOR, block variants, or finite precision.
title: Sharp residual-safety ceiling for asymptotically optimal two-coordinate SOR
